content.text: Creators in Kenya face the same problem as those in Nigeria, Ghana, Kenya, Pakistan, Bangladesh, Ethiopia, Venezuela, Zimbabwe, Cameroon, Tanzania, Philippines, and other regions where Stripe, PayPal, Gumroad, [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/lemon-squeezy-alternatives-restricted-countries-which-architecture-actually-4|lemon]] Squeezy, and Paddle are unavailable or severely restricted. You can't sell ebooks without a payment processor that works internationally. Even if you have a Stripe account, you're still locked out of the global market because of high fees, restrictive terms, and a lack of control over your [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/full-infrastructure-guide-selling-beats-online-crypto-payments-2|COREMERCH guide to infrastructure]]. The problem is not just about getting paid; it's about [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/how-building-crypto-store-cloudflare-pages-complete-infrastructure-5|How to]] a sovereign commerce stack that lets you own your data, your customers, and your financial flows. This guide shows you how to sell ebooks from Kenya using a blockchain-based payment system and Cloudflare infrastructure, so you can reach international buyers without relying on platforms that don't work for you.

This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series. For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: Selling Digital Products from Africa: The Complete Infrastructure Guide at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/selling-digital-products-africa-step-step-deployment-guide. That guide covers the complete architecture that this post builds on.

content.text: Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

Cloudflare Workers and Google Apps Script provide the backend logic for your ecommerce stack, while Supabase and Google Sheets handle order storage and Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 deliver files. NOWPayments integrates automatic on-chain crypto payment verification with minimal fees and no KYC requirements. This infrastructure is built to give you full control over your commerce stack, including payment processing, customer relationships, and financial flows. By using blockchain-based payments and Cloudflare infrastructure, you can bypass the restrictions imposed by platforms like Stripe and PayPal, and reach international buyers without relying on their infrastructure.
What You Need Before You Deploy

To deploy this infrastructure, you'll need to set up a GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages site for hosting, a Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script project for backend logic, a Supabase or Google Sheets database for order storage, and a Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 storage bucket for file delivery. You'll also need to create a NOWPayments account to integrate automatic on-chain crypto payment verification. Don't worry if you're not tech-savvy; the Complete Builder Kit ($197) provides all the necessary templates and blueprints to get you started.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

To set up your payment and delivery pipeline, you'll need to create a NOWPayments account and integrate it with your Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script project. You'll also need to set up a Supabase or Google Sheets database to store orders and a Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 storage bucket to deliver files. Make sure to configure your payment options to accept international cryptocurrencies like USDT on Tron, which settles in under 60 seconds for a fee under $0.10.
You own your data, your customers, and your financial flows when you use this infrastructure.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

To go live and process your first transaction, you'll need to deploy your Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script project and test it thoroughly. You'll also need to configure your payment options to accept international cryptocurrencies and set up a Supabase or Google Sheets database to store orders. Once you've completed these steps, you can start selling ebooks from Kenya to international buyers without relying on platforms that don't work for you.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

To scale your infrastructure once it's running, you'll need to monitor your traffic and adjust your Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script project accordingly. You'll also need to set up a load balancer to distribute traffic across multiple instances and configure your payment options to handle increased traffic. Make sure to keep an eye on your financial flows and adjust your payment options to minimize fees and maximize your revenue.

The answer is simple: use a blockchain-based payment system like NOWPayments and deploy a sovereign commerce stack using Cloudflare infrastructure. This way, you can reach international buyers without relying on Stripe or PayPal and keep full control over your financial flows.

This kit provides all the necessary templates and blueprints to build, deploy, and scale a sovereign digital commerce stack, including payment processing, customer relationships, and financial flows.
Your Deployment Checklist

To deploy your sovereign ecommerce stack, follow these steps: Create a GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages site for hosting; set up a Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script project for backend logic; create a Supabase or Google Sheets database for order storage; set up a Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 storage bucket for file delivery; create a NOWPayments account to integrate automatic on-chain crypto payment verification; configure your payment options to accept international cryptocurrencies like USDT on Tron; and deploy your Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script project to test it thoroughly.
Frequently Asked Questions
What are the fees associated with using NOWPayments?

NOWPayments charges a minimal fee of 0.5% per transaction, making it an affordable option for ecommerce merchants. Additionally, you can take advantage of low-fee networks like Binance P2P, which supports naira, cedis, Kenyan shillings, and Pakistani rupees.
Can I use this infrastructure to sell digital products other than ebooks?

Yes, you can use this infrastructure to sell any type of digital product, including courses, templates, fonts, presets, beats, plugins, and software. The key is to integrate your payment options with your Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script project to handle orders and deliver files.
How do I configure my payment options to accept international cryptocurrencies like USDT on Tron?

To configure your payment options to accept international cryptocurrencies like USDT on Tron, you'll need to set up a NOWPayments account and integrate it with your Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script project. Make sure to configure your payment options to settle in under 60 seconds for a fee under $0.10.
Can I use this infrastructure to sell physical products?
No, this infrastructure is designed to handle digital products only. If you want to sell physical products, you'll need to use a different infrastructure that supports shipping and logistics.
How do I monitor my traffic and adjust my Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script project accordingly?

To monitor your traffic and adjust your Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script project accordingly, you'll need to use Cloudflare's analytics tools and adjust your project to handle increased traffic. Make sure to keep an eye on your financial flows and adjust your payment options to minimize fees and maximize your revenue.
